m: मौघ्य n. (fr. मोघ) vanity, unprofitableness, uselessness, BhP.
a: मौघ्यं — Uselessness.

s: klI, (muKasyedamiti । muKa + aR .) muKasambanDADInapApam । tattu aBakzyaBakzaRarUpaM tatra klIvam । saMsargarUpasya tasya prAyaScittaM yaTA । sumantuH । yaSca tEryOnamOKaSrOvARAM sambanDAnAmanyatamena saha samparkkamiyAt tasyApyetadeva prAyaScittaM vidaDyAt । iyAt kuryyAt । etadeveti dvAdaSavArzikamityarTaH । atra yAjanAdInAmanyatamena saMvatsareRa patatItyavagamyate । iti SUlapARikftaprAyaScittavivekaH ॥ muKasambanDini, tri ॥
m: मौख mfn. (fr. मुख) relating to the mouth, oral (n. [?] a fault or defect connected with the mouth), Hariv.
based on oral instruction, Pat.
मौखरी f. = next, MW.
मौखर m. (fr. मुखर) N. of a family or race, Hcar.
मौखरि m. a patr. Vās., Introd.
a: मौखरिः — N. of a family; पदे पदे मौखरिभिः कृतार्चनं K.

m: मौखर्या f. of मौखरि above, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 79, Sch.
मौखर्य n. talkativeness, garrulity, Pañcar.
scurrility, defamation, abusiveness, calumny, MW.
a: मौखर्यं — [मुखरस्य मावः ष्यञ्] 1 Talkativeness, garrulity. --2 Abuse, defamation, calumny.

s: klI, muKaratvat । muKarasya BAva ityarTe zRyapratyayena nizpannam ॥
tri, muKasambanDi । muKasyedamityarTe zRik (Wak) pratyayena nizpannam ॥
m: मौखिक mfn. (fr. मुख), L.
मौख्य n. precedence, pre-eminence, Hit. (w.r.)
a: मौख्यं — Precedence, superiority.

मौंजी — The girdle of a Brāhmaṇa made of a triple string of Munja grass; Ku. 5. 10; Ms. 2. 42. --Comp. --निबंधनं, --बंधनं binding on the Munja grass girdle, investiture with the sacred thread; Ms. 2. 27, 169.
मौंज — a. (जी f.) [मुंज-अण्] Made of Munja grass (also मौंजक).
मौंड्यं — 1 Shaving of the head, tonsure. --2 Baldness.

s: klI, (mUQasya BAvaHkarmma vA । mUQa + “guRavacanabrAhmaRAdIByaH karmmaRi ca .” 5 । 1 । 124 । iti zyaY .) mohaH । iti hemacandraH । 2 । 234 ॥ (yaTA, SrImadBAgavate । 3 । 29 । 22 । “yomAM sarvvezu BUtezu santamAtmAnamISvaram । hitvArccAM Bajate mOQyAdBasmanyeva juhoti saH ॥” puM, mUQasyApatyam । mUQa + “kurvvAdiByo RyaH .” 4 । 1 । 151 । iti RyaH । mUQaputtraH । iti vyAkaraRam ॥)
v: na॰ mUQasya BAvaH zyaYa । 1 mohe hema॰ 2 bAlye ca ।
m: मौढ्य m. (fr. मूढ) patr. g. कुर्व्-आदी
मौढ्य n. stupidity, ignorance, folly, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
swoon, stupor, L.
a: मौढ्यं — 1 Ignorance, stupidity, folly. --2 Childishness. --3 Spiritual folly.

m: मौण्डिक n. shaving, L.
मौण्डि-निकाय m. (मौण्डि fr. मुण्ड) a proper N., Pāṇ. vi, 2, 94, Sch.
मौण्ड्य n. shaving the head, tonsure, baldness, Mn.; MBh. &c.
मौशल, मौषल, w.r. for मौसल below.
मौञ्जायनी f. a princess of the Mauñjāyanas g. शार्ङ्गरवादि.
मौञ्जाय˚नीय m. a prince of the Mauñjāyanas, g., दामन्य्-आदि.
मौञ्जायन m. patr. fr. मुञ्ज, g. नडादि
N. of a man, MBh.
pl. N. of a warlike family g. दामन्य्-आदि

s: strI, (muYjasyeyamiti । muYja + aR । striyAM NIp .) muYjanirmmitameKalA ॥ (yaTA, SiSupAlavaDe । 1 । 6 । “piSaNgamOYjIyujamarjjunacCaviM vasAnameRAjinamaYjanadyuti । suvarRasUtrAkalitAmbarADarAM viqambayantaM SitivAsasastanum ॥” “muYjastfRaviSezastanmayImeKalA mOYjI .” iti tawwIkAyAM mallInATaH ॥) yaTA, -- “viprasya kzattriyasyApi mOYjI syAddakziRAyane । dakziRe ca viSAM kAryyaM nAnaDyAye na saMkrame ॥” manuH । “mOYjI trivftsamA SlakzRA kAryyA viprasya meKalA । kzattriyasya ca mOrvvI jyAvESyasya SaRatAntavI ॥ muYjAlABe tu karttavyA kuSASmantakavalvajEH । trivftA granTinEkena triBiH paYcaBireva vA ॥” iti saMskAratattvam ॥
v: strI muYjasyeyam aR । kawisUtre trirAvfttamuYjakftAyAM meKalAyAm manuH ।
m: मौञ्जी (ई), f. See below.
मौञ्जी f. (scil. मेखला mc. also मौञ्जि) a Brāhman's girdle or cord made of a triple string of Muñja-grass
any girdle, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
मौञ्जी—धर mfn. wearing or carrying Muñja-grass, MBh.

s: puM, (mOYjyA banDaH banDanam .) muYjameKalAbanDanam । upanayanamiti yAvat । yaTA, “janmaBAdazwame siMhe nIcasTe SatruBe gurO । mOYcIbanDaH SuBaH proktaScEtre mInagate ravO ॥” iti jyotirnibanDe nAradavacanam ॥
v: pu॰ mOYjyA meKalAyA vanDoyatra । 1 upanayanasaskAre “mOYjIbanDaH SuBaH prAktaScEtre mInagate ravApi” ti jyo॰ । lyuw mOYjIbanDana tatrArTe na॰ । “dviWIyaM mOYjIbanDanam” manuH । 6 ta॰ । 2 tadbanDane ca ।

m: मौञ्जी—बन्धन n. = -निबनहन
मौञ्जी—बन्ध˚न-चिह्नित mfn. distinguished by the binding of the Muñja girdle, Mn. ii, 170.
मौञ्जी—निबन्धन n. the binding on of the girdle of Muñja-grass or of the sacred cord, Mn. ii, 27.
मौञ्जी—पत्त्रा f. Eleusine Indica, L.
मौञ्जी—तृणाख्य m. Muñja-grass, L.
मौञ्जीय mfn. made of Muñja-grass, BhavP.
मौञ्ज mf(ई)n. (fr. मुञ्ज) made of Muñja-grass or its fibres, TS. &c. &c.
resembling Muñja-grass or living on it, RV. i, 191, 3
मौञ्ज m. a blade of Muñja-grass, MW.
N. of a village of the Bāhīkas, L.
मौञ्जकायन m. a patr. Pravar.
मौञ्जक m. blades of Muñja-grass, VarBṛS. (v.l. मुञ्जक).
मौञ्जवत mf(ई)n. coming from the mountain Muñja-vat, Siddh. on Pāṇ. iv, 4, 110.
मौञ्ज—विवान mfn. twisted or fabricated out of Muñja-grass, ĀpŚr.
मौञ्जि-बन्धन n. = मौञ्जी-बन्धन, Mn. ii, 169, 171; Yājñ. i, 39.
मौञ्जिन् mfn. girt with or wearing a girdle of Muñja-grass, Hariv. (cf. नाग-म्˚औञ्जिन्).
मौञ्ज्य m. a partic. personification, Gaut.
मौच n. (fr. मोच) the fruit of the banana or plantain tree, Suśr.
a: मौचं — The fruit of the plantain tree.

m: मौदाकिन् m. (prob.) N. of a mountain, MBh. (v.l. मोदकिन्)
of a son of Bhavya and (n.) a Varṣa ruled by him, VP. (v.l. मौदकि).
मौद m. pl. (fr. मुद) N. of a school, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 66, Sch.
sg. a pupil of this school (see मौदक).
मौद—हायन m. a patr. (also pl.), Saṃskārak.
1. मौदक n. a partic. version of a sacred text adopted by Mauda, Pat.
2. मौदक mf(ई)n. (fr. मोदक) relating to sweetmeats, dealing with them, Cat.
a: मौदक — a. (की f.) 1 Relating to sweetmeats. --2 Dealing in sweetmeats.

m: मौद˚किक mf(ई)n. consisting or composed of sw˚, Pāṇ. v, 4, 22, Sch.
मौद˚किक m. a confectioner, Pāṇ. v, 4, 25, Sch.
a: मौदकिकः — A confectioner.

m: मौदमानिक mf(आ, or ई)n. (fr. मोदर्मान), g. काश्य्-आदि.
मौद˚नेयक mfn. g. कत्त्र्य्-आदि.
मौदनिक mf(आ or ई)n. (fr. मोदन) g. काश्य्-आदि.
मौद—पैप्पलाद m. pl. g. कार्त-कौजपादि.

s: klI, (mudgAnAM BavanaM kzetramiti । mudga + “DAnyAnAM Bavane kzetre KaY .” 5 । 2 । 1 । iti KaY .) mudgaBavocitakzetram । ityamaraH । 2 । 9 । 8 ॥
v: na॰ mudgAnAM BavanaM kzetraM KaY । mudgaBavaneyogye kzetre amaraH ।
m: मौद्गीन mf(ई)n. sown with beans, Pāṇ. v, 2, 1, Sch.
a: मौद्गीन — a. [मुद्गानां भवनं क्षेत्रं खञ्] Fit for being sown with beans, or sown with beans (as a field).

k.v: मौद्गीनकौद्रवीणादि शेषधान्योद्भवक्षमम्. शाकक्षेत्रादिके शाकशाकटं शाकशाकिनम्. बीजाकृतं तूप्तकृष्टे सीत्यं कृष्टं च हल्यवत्.।

m: मौद्ग mf(आ)n. (fr. मुद्य) relating to a bean, consisting of beans, KātyŚr.; Suśr.
मौद्ग m. N. of a preceptor, VP.
मौद्गलीय mfn. (fr. मौद्गल्य) g. कृशाश्-वादि.
मौद्गलि m. (fr. मुद्गल) a crow, L.
a: मौद्गलिः — A crow.

m: मौद्गलि—केर m. a patr. L.
मौद्गल्यायन m. (patr. fr. Prec.) N. of a pupil of Gautama Buddha, Lalit.

s: puM, (mudgalasyApatyamiti । mudgala + zyaY .) mudgalamuniputtraH । sa ca gotrakArakaH । asya paYca pravarAH yaTA । OrvvacyavanaBArgavajAmadagnyApnuvantaH । iti kuladIpikA ॥ (yaTA, harivaMSe । 32 । 70 । “mudgalasya tu dAyAdo mOdgalyaH sumahAyaSAH ॥)
v: pu॰ mudgalasya munergotrApatyaM gargA॰ yaY । sudgala gotrApatye muniBede ।
m: मौद्गल्य mfn. descended or sprung from Mudgala, BhP.
मौद्गल्य m. patr. of Nāka, ŚBr.
of Śatabalākṣa, Nir.
of Lāṅgalāyana, AitBr.
N. of a chamberlain, Mālav.
a partic. mixed caste, MBh.
मौद्गिक mfn. purchased with beans, Pāṇ. v, 1, 37, Vārtt. 3, Pat.
मौद्रिक m. (fr. मुद्रा) a maker of seal rings (?), L.
मौग्ध (w.r. Sāh.; Uttarar.) or मौग्ध्य (ib.; Kathās. &c.), n. (fr. मुग्ध), simplicity, innocence, inexperience, a feminine grace (asking a lover to tell what is already known); charm, beauty, MW.

a: मौग्ध्यं — [मुग्ध-ष्यञ्] 1 Silliness, foolishness. --2 Artlessness, simplicity, innocence. --3 Charm, beauty

m: मौहूर्त m. (fr. मुहूर्त) an astrologer, MBh.
a: मौहूर्तः — [मुहूर्त-अण्] An astrologer.

m: मौहूर्तिक mfn. lasting for a moment, momentary, BhP.
relating to a particular time or hour, ib.
skilled in astrology, Kāv.
मौहूर्तिक m. an astrologer, Kāv.; Kathās.; Hit.
मौहूर्तिक m. pl. N. of a class of celestial beings (children of Muhūrtā), BhP.
a: मौहूर्तिक — a. (की f.) [मुहूर्त-ठक्] Momentary, transient. --कः An astrologer; मौहूर्तिकैः संवाद्यताम्.

s: puM, (mUhUrttaM aDIte veda vA । muhUrtta + “tadaDIte tadveda .” 4 । 2 । 50 । ityaR .) jyotirvvettA । ityamaraH । 2 । 8 । 14 ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 12 । 121 । 46 । “BikzukAH prAqvivAkASca mOhUrttA dEvacintakAH ॥”)
v: pu॰ muhUrttaM tatpratipAdakaM SAstraM vettyaDIte vA'R । jyotiHSAstrajYe । Wak । mOhUrttika tatrEva amaraH ।

s: puM, (muhUrttaM tadboDakaM SAstramaDIte veda vA । mUhUrtta + “kratUkTAdisUtrAntAt Wak .” 4 । 2 । 60 । iti Wak .) jyotirvvettA । ityamaraH । 2 । 8 । 14 ॥ (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 22 । 133 । “tato mOhUrttikAdeSAdanyedyurvvarakanyakA । sA mayA pariRItA BUnmilitAKilabanDunA ॥” dakzakanyAmuhUrttodBavadevagaRaviSezaH । yaTA, BAgavate । 6 । 6 । 9 । “mOhUrttikA devagaRA muhUrttAyASca jajYire ॥” muhUrttodBave, tri । yaTA, BAgavate । 5 । 13 । 22 । “mOhUrttikAdyasya samAgamAcca me dustarkamUlo'pahato'vivekaH ॥”)

m: मौहनिक m. (fr. मोहन) N. of Caitra, L.
मौजदीन m. N. of a Sultān, Inscr.
मौजवत mfn. coming from or produced on the mountain Mūja-vat, RV.; Nir.
मौजवत m. (said to be) a patr. of Akṣa (author of RV. x, 34).
मौक m. patr. fr. मूक, ĀśvŚr.
मौकलि m. a raven, L. (cf. मौकुलि; मौद्गलि).
a: मौक(कु)लिः — A crow; U. 2. 29.

k.v: काके तु करटारिष्टबलिपुष्टसकृत्प्रजाः। ध्वाङ्क्षात्मघोषपरभृद्बलिभुग्वायसा अपि॥ स एव च चिरञ्जीवी चैकदृष्टिश्च मौकुलिः।

m: मौकल्य m. a Vaidehaka who sews and dyes clothes (also called a Rāmaka), L.
मौक्तिकाभ mfn. like p˚, MW.
मौक्तिका-हार m. id., Mālatīm.
मौक्तिकावलि (Kir.) or मौक्तिकाव˚ली (Kathās.), f. a pearl necklace.

s: klI, (mukteva । muktA + “vinayAdiByazWak .” 5 । 4 । 34 । iti Wak .) muktA । ityamaraH । 2 । 9 । 92 ॥ (yaTA, cARakyaSatake । 55 । “SEle SEle na mARikyaM mOktikaM na gaje gaje । sADavo nahi sarvvatra candanaM na vane vane ॥” taTAsya paryyAyaH । “mOktikaM SOktikaM muktA taTA muktAPalaYca tat । aBAve mOktikasyApi muktASuktiM prayojayet ॥” iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvaKaRqe dbitIye BAge ॥)
v: na॰ muktEva svArTe Wak । muktAyAm amaraH ।
m: मौक्तिक mfn. (fr. मुक्ति) striving after final emancipation, Pañcat.
मौक्तिक m. (only in MBh.) n. (fr. मुक्ता; comp. f(आ). ) a pearl (properly ‘a collection of p˚’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: मौक्तिकं — [मुक्तैव स्वार्थे ठक्] A pearl; मोक्तिकं न गजे गजे Subhāṣ. --Comp. --आवली a string of pearls. --गुंफिका a female who prepares pearlnecklaces. --दामन् n. a string of pearls. --प्रसवा a pearl-muscle. --शुक्तिः f. a pearl-oyster. --सरः a necklace or string of pearls; अयं कंठे बाहुः शिशिरमसृणा मौक्तिकसरः U. 1. 29.

k.v: गारुत्मतं मरकतमश्मगर्भो हरिन्मणिः। शोणरत्नं लोहितकः पद्मरागोऽथ मौक्तिकम्.।

s: strI, (mOktikAnAM SuktiH .) SuktiH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ muktAra Jinuk iti BAzA ॥
m: मौक्तिक—शुक्ति f. a pearl oyster, L.
मौक्तिक—दामन् n. a string of p˚, L.
a kind of metre, Col.
मौक्तिक—गुम्फिका f. a female stringer of p˚, KāśīKh.
मौक्तिक—माला f. a pearl necklace, L.
a species of metre, Col.
मौक्तिक—मारण n. N. of a subject treated of in the Dhātu-ratna—mālā, Cat.
मौक्तिक—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of pearls, Śṛṅgār.

v: strI mOktikaM prasUte pra + sU--ac । muktAsPowe SuktO rAjani॰ ।
m: मौक्तिक—प्रसवा f. a pearl muscle, L. (cf. मुक्ता-प्रसू).
मौक्तिक—रत्न n. a pearl gem, pearl (-ता f.), Rājat.
मौक्तिक—रत्न—ता f.
मौक्तिक—सर m. a string of p˚, Nalac.; Uttarar.

s: puM, (mOktikamiva SuklaH taRqulo'sya .) DavalayAvanAlaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
m: मौक्तिक—तण्डुल m. a kind of white Yāvanāla, L.

s: puM, kAkaH । iti hemacandraH । 4 । 388 ॥ (yaTA, uttararAmacarite 2 aNke । “kUjatkuYjakuwIrakOSikaGawAGutkAravat kIcakastambAqambaramUkamOkulikulaH krOYcAvato'yaM giriH । etasmin pracalAkinAM pracalatAmudvejitAH kUjitErudbellanti purARacandanataruskanDezu kumBInasAH ॥”)
m: मौकुलि m. a crow, Uttarar. (cf. मौकलि).
मौकुन्द mfn. relating to Mukunda i.e. Viṣṇu, Pañcar.
मौक्य n. (fr. मूक) dumbness, speechlessness, Mn. xi, 51.
a: मौक्यं — [मूकस्य भावः ष्पञ्] Dumbness, muteness, speechlessness.

m: मौक्ष n. (fr. मोक्ष) N. of a Sāman, Lāṭy.
मौक्षिक mfn. relating to the release of a planet (from eclipse) or to the end of an ecl˚, Sūryas.
मौली f. the earth, L.
मौलीन्दु m. the moon on (Śiva's) h˚, Hcat.

s: puM, (mUlaM vedeti । mUla + aR .) BUmyAdermUlajYAtA । moqal iti BAzA । yaTA, -- “yat paramparayA mOlAH sAmantAH svAminaM viduH । tadanvayasyAgatasya dAtavyA gotrajErmahI ॥” iti dAyatattvam ॥ tasya lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “ye tatra pUrvvaM sAmantAH paScAddeSAntaraM gatAH । tanmUlatvAttu te mOlA fziBiH parikIrttitAH ॥” iti mitAkzarA ॥ (vijigIzvarimaDyodAsInaH । yaTA, kAmandakIye । 8 । 34 । “catvAraH pArTivA mOlAH pfTaNmitrEH sahAzwakam ॥” mUlaBUte, tri । yaTA, tatrEva । 8 । 25 । “mOlA dvAdaSa yAstvetA hyamAtyAdyAstaTA ca yAH । saptatiScADikA hyatAH sarvvaM prakftimaRqalam ॥”)
v: tri॰ BUlaM vetti mUlAdAgato vA'R । BUmyAderAgamAdimUlajYe, “yaM paramparayA mOlAH sAmantAH svAminaM vidu” riti smftiH 2 mUlAdAgate ca ।
m: मौल mf(आ)n. (fr. मूल) derived from roots (as poison), Hcar.
handed down from antiquity, ancient (as a custom), MBh.
holding office from previous generations, hereditary (as a minister or warrior), Mn.; MBh. &c.
aboriginal, indigenous, Mn. viii, 62; 259
मौल m. an hereditary minister (holding his office from father and grandfather), Ragh.; Daś.
मौल m. pl. aboriginal inhabitants who have emigrated, L.
मौल m. (with पार्थिवाः) = मूलप्रकृतयः, Kām.

a: मौलि — a. [मूलस्यादूरभवः इञ्] Head, foremost, best; अखिलपरिमलानां मौलिना सौरभेण Bv. 1. 121. --लिः 1 The head, the crown of the head; मौलौ वा रचयांजलिं Ve. 3. 40; R. 13. 59; Ku. 5. 79. --2 The head or top of anything, top-most point; U. 2. 30. --3 The Aśoka tree. --लिः (m. f.) 1 A crown, diadem, tiara; Bv. 1. 73. --2 Hair on the crown of the head, tuft or lock of hair; जटामौलि Ku. 2. 26 (जटाजूट Malli.). --3 Braided hair, hair braided and ornamented; Ve. 6. 34; --लिः, --ली f. m: मौर्य—दत्त m. N. of a man, Daś.
मौर्य—पुत्र m. (with Jainas) N. of one of the eleven Gaṇādhipas, W.
मौसल mf(ई)n. (fr. मुसल) club-shaped, club-formed, ĀśvŚr.; R.
fought with clubs (as a battle), MBh.; Hariv.
relating to the battle with clubs (cf. -पर्वन्)
N. of a Madhu-parka (composed of ghee and spirituous liquor), Kauś.
relating to Mausalya g. कण्वादि
मौसल m. pl. N. of a family, Saṃskārak.
a: मौसल — a. (ली f.) [मुसल-अण्] 1 Formed like a club, club-shaped. --2 Fought with clubs (as a battle). --3 Relating to the battle with clubs (as a parvan; in this parvan is narrated the death of Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma, and the self-destruction of Kṛṣṇa's family through the curse of Brāhmaṇas). --लः A kind of madhuparka.

m: मौसल—पर्वन् n. ‘Musala-section’, N. of the 16th book of the Mahā-bhārata (so called after the self-slaughter in a club-fight of Kṛṣṇa's family, the Yādavas, through the curse of some Brāhmans, IW. 374).
मौसल्य m. patr. fr. मुसल, g. गर्गादि.
मौसुल m. = مسلم a Moslim, Musalmān, Cat.
मौत्र n. (fr. मूत्र) a quantity of urine, GṛŚrS. (cf. अ-मौत्र-धौत).
a: मौत्रं — A quantity of urine.

m: मौत्र-कृच्छ्रिक mf(ई)n. (fr. मूत्र कृच्छ्र) resembling strangury, Car.

s: klI, (mUzalamiva । mUzalasyedamiti vA । mUzala + aR .) mUzalavat । yaTA, -- “gaNgAyAM mOzalaM snAnaM mahApAtakanASanam .” iti prAyaScittatattvaDftaBavizyapurARavacanam ॥ mahABAratasyAzwAdaSaparvvAntargataparvvaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “mOzalaM parvva coddizwaM tato GoraM sudAruRam । mahAprasTAnikaM parvva svargArohaRikaM tataH ॥” iti mahABArate Adiparvva ॥ muzalasambanDini, tri ॥
v: na॰ muzalasyedam tatsadfSaM vA'R । 1 muzalasambanDini 2 muzalatulyaniScezwe “gaNgAyAM mOzalaM snAnaM mahApAtakanASanam” iti purARam । muzalamaDikftya kfto granTaH aR । mahABAratAntargate “muzalaM kulanASanam” ityAdipratipAdake zoqaSe 3 parvaRi ।

m: मौषिकार m. a male mouse, Pat. on Pāṇ. iv, 1, 120.
मौषिकी-पुत्र m. N. of a teacher, ŚBr.
मौषिक mfn. (fr. मूषिका) relating or belonging to a mouse, Pañcat.
मौषिकि m. metron. fr. मूषिका, g. बाह्व्-आदि.

s: strI, muzwipraharaRakrIqA । ityamaraH । 3 । 5 । 5 ॥ “muzwipraharaRaM asyAM krIqAyAM mOzwA zRaH (aR) Rittve vririti vfdDiH yayorlApa iti ikAralopaH । striyAmata ityAp .” iti tawwIkAyAM BarataH ॥
m: मौष्टा f. (fr. मुष्टि) a combat with fists, boxing match, L.
a: मौष्टा — Playing at fisticuffs, a boxing or pugilistic encounter.

m: मौष्टिक m. a cheat, rogue, sharper, Buddh.
a goldsmith, L.
a: मौष्टिकः — A rogue, cheat, sharper.
